steps.text: The glass hides the subtitles in the video
Turn on Show the whole answer
Type what you hear and press Enter
Every mistake at once: red is wrong, green is right
Fix them in the box. The wrong word is selected
Want to read the subtitles? Turn off Cover subtitles
Turn it on again to hide them
Not over the words? Move or resize the cover
Pull an edge, or drag the glass
